text: Armed school police guards have been proven to prevent school shootings.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.note: 18% definitely true, 42% probably true; the false share is the published remainder. KFF offered definitely/probably true and probably/definitely false; the small remainder gave no answer.

truthSource.label: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management (2023)
truthSource.oneLine: A national study of U.S. schools from 2014 to 2018 found that school resource officers reduce some forms of school violence but do not prevent gun-related incidents.

lesson.tip: If something were proven, someone could name the study. A policy that sounds protective isn’t evidence that it works.
